description:
Which keys served one task — the task id your PAT was minted with (metadata.task_id).
Returns your brand's requests for that task grouped by serving key and request kind: attempts,
success/errors, prompt/completion tokens, first_at/last_at, and lease_count + lease_ids for a lease.
Counts and ids only — never a prompt, a completion or a credential.

The brand is your credential's; there is no brand_id here.

READ `key.owned_by`:
- own — your own key: integration_id, label, provider, plan.
- group:<name> — a connected company's key: integration_id, provider, plan; never its label.
- pool — the shared pool: integration_id and label are null, and all pool rows of one provider
  and kind are ONE group, so the pool's keys cannot be counted from this answer.
- unknown — the row recorded no key (a refusal before a key was chosen).
`plan` is the provider's published tier for that key's subscription_tier, or null.

`attempts` counts rows, one per attempt: a retried turn counts each attempt. Never quote it as
"requests". An unknown task id is an empty result, not an error. Requests made before the
task_id passthrough reached a lane (lease, embeddings, media, judge) carry no task_id and are
not found; chat always carried it. `truncated: true` means more than 50 groups matched — narrow
with since/until.

since.description: Inclusive lower bound, ISO-8601. Naive values read as UTC.

until.description: Exclusive upper bound, ISO-8601. Naive values read as UTC.

name: gate_usage_by_task
